name: Taiwanese Student Association (TSA UW)
description: Founded in 2001, the largest UW student organization for Taiwanese students and culture, open to anyone interested in Taiwan; it runs UW Night Market, the biggest night market in Seattle.
meeting_schedule: Event-based: general meetings each quarter (Fall Gen, Winter Gen) plus socials; times and rooms are posted on Instagram @tsauw
fit_reason: Anyone curious about Taiwanese culture who wants big events, food and friends.

application.deadline: Fall 2026 recruitment: social days Oct 5-6, interviews Oct 8-12 (invite only)
steps: For the fall recruitment track: orientation and social days, then invite-only group and individual interviews
